script.opening_words:
Are you sabotaging your own retirement
without even realizing it? What if I
told you that the biggest threat to your
financial future isn't market crashes,
inflation, or even unexpected expenses,
but rather seven simple mistakes that
millions of people make with their 401k
every single day. These aren't obscure
financial blunders that require a PhD in
economics to understand. These are basic
errors that cost ordinary people
hundreds of thousands of dollars over
their working careers. And the tra
script.ending_words:
tively billions of dollars in lost
retirement wealth. But the beautiful
thing is that now you know exactly what
to avoid. Start capturing that employer
match tomorrow. Invest for growth
instead of hiding in cash. Keep those
fees low. Resist the loan temptation.
Stay invested through market chaos.
Never cash out when changing jobs. And
most importantly, start today rather
than waiting for the perfect moment.
Your future self will thank you for
taking action now. And honestly, your
future self deserves a comfortable
retirement after putting up with all
your questionable decisions over the
years.
